title: SCP-066, Eric's Toy
description: "Are you Eric?" asks SCP-066, an unpredictable toy, causing loud music when provoked
body:
Eric's Toy adds a new mob. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-066, also known as Eric's Toy.


This strange mass of red strings with eyes constantly rolls around, repeating the name "Eric" and occasionally producing musical notes. It may seem harmless at first, but if you get too close, it will suddenly play extremely loud music that can deafen you, or kill you. However, there’s a twist. A bunt version of SCP-066 exists without eyes, and it behaves far more peacefully. This variant plays gentle tunes. But be careful. Don’t use shears on it, or it will transform back into the deadly original version, ready to harm. 

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-066 spawn?

SCP-066 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-066.

</details>



![SCP-066](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0caa1ee1b6004cc9fa30eabf2bb60c92bb5d18ee.png)

SCP-066 is a strange mass of red threads with eyes. It is neutral and constantly repeats the name “Eric.” It rolls around and can randomly play musical notes as it moves. You can pick up SCP-066 by sneaking and right-clicking on it, and it can be placed back down anywhere. However, colliding with SCP-066 will cause it to play extremely loud music, which makes the screen shake, deals damage, and deafens the player for 1 minute.

 

- Config File not inculed.
